name: Coin Dissolving Fountain
description: An ornate stone fountain where copper coins tossed into its waters dissolve into schools of glowing koi fish that swim away, creating a spectacle of transformation and magic.
prompt: An ornate Baroque-style stone fountain in the center of a bustling plaza, water cascading dramatically. Copper coins tossed into the water begin to dissolve and transform into glowing koi fish made of golden light. The fish swim away in elegant schools. Golden hour lighting, urban setting, magical realism, ultra-detailed, 8k
caption: Every coin tells a story—especially when it turns into a swimming wish! 💰🐟✨ What would you wish for if your pocket change could become magical fish? The fountain grants more than you think. Drop a 🎋 if you believe in transformations!
